paragraphs: (A student of Rav Kahana, Rav Ashi’s teacher.) He took a large part in Rav Ashi’s academy, as Hyman says we always find: “Rav Hillel said to Rav Ashi: When I was at Rav Kahana’s,” as in Shabbat 109a, Beitzah 40a, Yevamot 21b and 26a, Bava Batra 98a and Chullin 53a. He likewise said to Rav Ashi, “There was a case at Rav Kahana’s,” as in Avodah Zarah 69a; and he said to him, “I myself saw Mar son of Ravna’s [list of] secondary [forbidden relations],” as in Yevamot 21b.

notes.text: The final phrase concerns sheniyot, secondary forbidden relationships, not a mishnah list. Saved Davidson Yevamot 21b has Rav Hillel himself seeing Mar son of Ravna’s list. The first-person singular “when I was” and Hyman’s always assertion remain explicit.
